reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Matthew 6:7's ban on vain repetitions as targeting hollow, mechanical babbling, not the faith-filled asking Luke's parables commend.

discrepancy.emptyNote: This tension is catalogued in the project's sources, but its public-domain survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.verseText: In praying, don't use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

sides.snippet: keep asking, and it will be given you
sides.verseText: \"I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
